Accessibility

Franklin Navigator is designed for keyboard use, clear headings, readable contrast, zoom and reduced-motion preferences.

Keyboard navigation

Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move through links and controls. A skip link appears when focused so you can move directly to the main content.

Zoom and responsive layout

Pages adapt to phones, tablets and large screens, and the layout is designed to remain usable when browser text is enlarged.

Motion and contrast

The site honors reduced-motion preferences and uses visible focus indicators with high-contrast text and controls.

External resources

Linked third-party sites have their own accessibility support. Contact the responsible organization directly if an external source is difficult to use.
